INTEGRATED 
MOBILITY 
In partnership with local, regional, and state transportation 
agencies, the City will expand mobility options and provide for 
safe, convenient, and efficient transitions between different modes 
of travel. Dependence on the private automobile will be reduced 
through an increasingly diverse transportation network supported 
by emerging technologies that connect residents, workers, and 
visitors to transit, micro-mobility devices, rideshare, and other 
mobility services. With little opportunity to accommodate 
additional private vehicle traffic, the City will seek to reduce vehicle 
miles traveled (VMT) through more consciously coordinated land 
use and transportation planning.
